card.name: Space after "every" before a number
card.fires_on: The blank space right after the word "every" in dosing or screening schedules, where a number and a unit of time (hours, days, weeks, months, years) comes next.

modes.label: Dosing interval
modes.description: Space after "every" in a drug dose schedule, before a number of hours, days or weeks.
modes.example: The recommended dosage of ELFABRIO, based on actual body weight, is 1 mg/kg administered by intravenous infusion every<< >>2 weeks.

modes.label: Screening interval
modes.description: Space after "every" in a repeat-testing schedule, before a number of years.
modes.example: If no polyp is found, subsequent colonoscopies and upper GI endoscopies (or alternate imaging) should be done no less frequently than every<< >>5 years.

modes.label: Table cell starting with Every
modes.description: Space after a capitalized "Every" in a dosing table.
modes.example: AVEO 2 g (aztreonam 1.5 grams and avibactam 0.5 grams) 3 hours Every<< >>6 hours Greater than 30 to

card.writes: It pushes the model toward a number and a short time span after "every", and away from words like annual, yearly and monthly.
card.plain: It fires on the gap after "every" when a number of hours, days, weeks or years is about to follow.
